items:
Beach Bliss is brimming with casual, coastal charms and is located within the gated community of WaterSound West Beach. This Florida cottage features four bedrooms, three full bathrooms, one half bathroom, a retreat, and two porches overlooking the green space of Horseshoe Park. WaterSound West Beach is a gated community with security patrol.

*Dogs over 1 year old are permitted ONLY WITH OWNER APPROVAL and a non-refundable dog fee. Please include this information in your inquiry email. Large, high shedding dogs are not permitted at the house. Beach Bliss does not come with a golf cart and renters are not able to rent a golf cart.

The garage is filled with anything you can think of for a day at the beach and are included with the rental of Beach Bliss -
*Stand up paddleboard with wheels to transport the SUP to the beach
*One person kayak with wheels to transport the kayak to the beach
*Beach chairs
*Beach umbrellas
*Five bikes
*Wagon
*Cooler
*Boogie Boards
*Balls and sand toys
Please note that life preservers and bike helmets are not included.

Beach Bliss's First Floor-
*Drop off center with hooks and bench at entrance.
*First master bedroom with a king size bed, TV, walk in shower with 2 shower heads, double sinks, and large closet.
*Half bathroom with driftwood mirror made by a local artist.
*Laundry room with washer and dryer.
*Gather in the family room which has a Smart TV and baskets of games for kids and adults!
*The bright kitchen is stocked with everything a cook could ever need. The breakfast bar seats 3 people.
*The dining room table seats 8-9 people.
*Enjoy dining al fresco in the screened in porch.
*Grill on the gas grill adjacent to the screened in porch.
*Enclosed outdoor shower with hot and cold water.
*Garage for storage.
*Tesla charger-Generation 2, 220V, charging cable not provided, renter must bring their own charging cable, please charge in the driveway.

Beach Bliss's Second Floor-
*The upstairs master bedroom is bright and airy and has a king size bed, TV, and a large walk in closet. The connected sitting room has 2 chairs and a desk for working or studying. A french door leads out to the private upstairs porch overlooking peaceful Horseshoe Park. The private bathroom has a walk in shower with 2 shower heads and double sinks.
*The third bedroom has a queen size bed with a closet and TV.
*The fourth bedroom is a bunk room with 2 FULL size beds.
*The retreat has a full size sleeper sofa
*The upstairs bathroom has a large soaker tub.

Beach Bliss is a 10 minute walk or a 5 minute bike ride to the prettiest beach on 30A. All you need to do is follow the meandering boardwalks that lead to the pool and beach. You will cross a nature preserve and dune lake as you enter the beach. It's stunning! The dune lake that is located at the entrance to the beach flows in and out of the Gulf of Mexico. Kids love to skim board in the lake. The SUP and kayak can be brought in to the ocean or lake. You will love this quiet stretch of beach.

The resort pool is available to WaterSound West Beach residents and guests. There is a refrigerator and a grill at the pool and tables and chairs for dining. The pool has lanais and plenty of lounge chairs. There is also a puttering green for mini golf right near the pool and green space.

When you venture on 30A, you will find that there is tons to do, see, and eat. The lively eateries are within a few miles of Beach Bliss. WaterSound West Beach is conveniently located in the middle of all the action on 30A. To the west of Beach Bliss are Seagrove, Seaside, WaterColor, and Grayton Beach. To the east of Beach Bliss are Seacrest, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach. Guaranteed you will find fresh, delicious food, fun, and shopping here! Whether you want to relax or take advantage of all of the activities in the area, your time at Beach Bliss will fly by!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
